meta.title: About
meta.description: Why Brivia brings hosting, learning and assessment together in one tool.

AboutPage.title: Interactivity serves
AboutPage.intro: Brivia brings the moment in the room together with the work that continues after. A continuity designed around people, not features.
AboutPage.heroImageAlt: A group talks around a table during a learning workshop
AboutPage.missionIntro: A session can start with a poll, continue as a course and end with an exam. The tool should follow that movement instead of imposing its own logic.
AboutPage.missionExtra1: We believe learning and engagement should be dynamic, collaborative and enjoyable. That's why we built Brivia, an all-in-one platform that lets educators, trainers and hosts design interactive experiences people actually remember.
AboutPage.missionExtra2: Whether you're running a classroom quiz, a company poll, or flashcards for revision, Brivia gives you the tools to hold your audience's attention and measure the impact in real time.
AboutPage.valuesSummary: Brivia. Live participation, learning and assessment in one interactive platform.

values.title: Innovation
values.desc: We keep pushing for experiences that feel more engaging and more intuitive.

values.title: Collaboration
values.desc: We make teamwork easier and encourage sharing what people learn.

values.title: Simplicity
values.desc: Powerful tools that stay simple to use, for everyone.

values.title: Commitment
values.desc: We care about what we build and invest fully in your success.

AboutPage.closingText: The best way to judge this vision is still to see the product run in front of a real audience.

faq.question: Is Brivia really free to start?
faq.answer: Yes. The Starter plan lets you create up to 5 pieces of content and welcome 20 participants per session, with no time limit.

faq.question: Do participants need to create an account?
faq.answer: No. They join with a six-character code or QR code directly from their browser.

faq.question: Where is the data hosted?
faq.answer: Application data is hosted in a European region, as documented in the Trust Center.

faq.question: Can I export the results?
faq.answer: Yes, from the Pro plan. Detailed reports can be exported for further analysis.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: The Pro plan is paid by card through Stripe, our secure payment processor. Your card details never pass through our servers.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.a: Yes. From your profile, open the Stripe billing portal to cancel in one click. Pro access stays active until the end of the period already paid for, then your account automatically returns to Starter.
There's no separate trial, but the Starter plan is free with no time limit (up to 5 pieces of content and 20 participants per session) — enough to try Brivia before moving to Pro.
The Pro plan is billed €19/month, with no commitment. There's no annual plan yet.

items.q: What happens if my payment fails?
items.a: Stripe automatically retries the charge for a few days; your Pro access stays active during that period. If the payment ultimately fails, your account moves back to the Starter plan.
Yes, your full invoice history is available at any time in the Stripe billing portal, accessible from your profile.

items.q: How does Enterprise plan billing work?
items.a: The Enterprise plan is quote-based: contact our sales team to define your needs, and billing is adapted to your organization.
